name: George Borrello

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Rushford, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Rushford, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town justice of the town of West Almond, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town justice of the town of West Almond, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town, so long as such person resides in Allegany county.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Joseph Fredrick to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be eligible for employment as a full-time police officer with the village of Allegany
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Joseph Fredrick to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police officer with the village of Allegany.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax not exceeding five percent of the per diem rental rate for each room.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Batavia to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Batavia to impose a hotel and motel tax not exceeding five percent of the per diem rental rate for each room.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Olean assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from OWH Properties, Inc. (Operation Warm Hearts)
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Oleans assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from OWH Properties, Inc. (Operation Warm Hearts) for all of the 2025-2026 school taxes and all of the 2025 general taxes.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Lt. Gary A. Scott
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Lt. Gary A. Scott in the town of LeRoy, county of Genesee.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town clerk of the town of Bethany, county of Genesee, to be nonresidents of such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town clerk of the town of Bethany, county of Genesee, to be nonresidents of such town.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to 2LT Edward Dixon Neal
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system on state route 20A in the county of Wyoming to 2LT Edward Dixon Neal.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a program to conduct annual audits of commercial driver's license records maintained by the department of motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Establishes a program to conduct annual audits of commercial driver's license records maintained by the department of motor vehicles; requires the department of motor vehicles to notify licensees of deficiencies and provide an opportunity to cure such deficiencies; requires annual reporting to the governor and legislature; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Michael Hall to file a request for change of benefit coverage with the New York state teachers' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Michael Hall to file a request for change of benefit coverage with the New York state teachers' retirement system.
sponsored.fis: Any costs attributable to implementation of the retirement election option change, authorized by section one of this act, shall be borne by the employers of members of the New York state teachers' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the city of Dunkirk to issue bonds and requires such city to adhere to all collective bargaining agreements entered into
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the city of Dunkirk to issue bonds under the city of Dunkirk fiscal recovery act until 2026; requires the city of Dunkirk to adhere to all collective bargaining agreements entered into; directs the city to adopt a local law approving the city of Dunkirk fiscal recovery act; provides that if the city treasurer position is no longer active, the mayor of the city of Dunkirk shall handle the requirements of the former city treasurer.
sponsored.fis: The State Comptroller's administrative responsibilities under this Act could be accomplished within existing resources. By authorizing the City to issue deficit bonds, this bill would help the City to restore its fund balance while also maintaining adequate essential services. The bill's enhanced fiscal oversight of the City and Special Debt Service Fund would improve the City's ability to market future bond and note issues at a lower cost. Any fiscal impact on the State would be negligi- ble.

sponsored.t: Provides a state income tax exemption for police officers
sponsored.sum: Provides a state income tax exemption for police officers up to one hundred thousand dollars.
sponsored.fis: This bill would reduce personal income tax revenues to the extent eligi- ble resident police officers claim the exemption. The precise fiscal impact would depend on the number of eligible taxpayers and the amount of exempt income claimed annually.

sponsored.t: Relates to residency requirements for police officers in the village of Medina
sponsored.sum: Relates to residency requirements for police officers in the village of Medina in the county of Orleans.
sponsored.fis: None to the state. Potential cost savings to the Village of Medina through improved recruitment and reduced turnover.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the towns of Ellington and Charlotte in Chautauqua county to elect a single town justice to preside in the town courts of such towns
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the towns of Ellington and Charlotte in Chautauqua county to elect a single town justice to preside in the town courts of such towns.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city school district of the city of Salamanca to establish a reserve fund for federal impact aid in the event such aid is reduced
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city school district of the city of Salamanca to establish a reserve fund for federal impact aid in the event such aid is reduced.

sponsored.t: Increases penalties for reckless operation and unauthorized modification of electric personal mobility devices
sponsored.sum: Provides a tiered penalty structure for the reckless operation of electric personal mobility devices including fines, confiscation of the device and potential misdemeanor charges; provides penalties for the illegal modification of electric personal mobility devices.

sponsored.t: Establishes a non-emergency medical transportation administrative modernization pilot program to strengthen program integrity and reduce improper payments
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pilot program to implement a unified administrative platform for the authorization, coordination, monitoring, and payment of non-emergency medical transportation services.
sponsored.fis: The pilot shall be implemented within available appropriations. By improving verification and reporting tools, the State may identify administrative efficiencies and reductions in improper payments leading to substantial cost savings.

sponsored.t: Waives the registration fee and service charge for distinctive plates for certain volunteer firefighters and certain members of volunteer ambulance services
sponsored.sum: Waives the registration fee and service charge for distinctive plates for volunteer firefighters and members of volunteer ambulance services where the applicant has attended twenty-five percent or more of the emergency calls for the previous year.

sponsored.t: Establishes temporary reduced speeds on the New York state thruway in certain weather conditions and requires instruction in winter weather conditions safety as part of the drivers pre-licensing course
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary reduced speed limit of forty-five miles per hour on the New York state thruway in certain winter weather conditions; creates penalties for violating such reduced speed limit; requires instruction in winter weather conditions safety as part of the drivers pre-licensing course.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Mayville to transfer the funds of the the Mayville ambulance reserve fund and the Mayville fire and rescue equipment reserve fund to the North Lake Fire District reserve accounts
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Mayville to transfer the funds of the Mayville ambulance reserve fund and the Mayville fire and rescue equipment reserve fund to the newly formed North Lake Fire District reserve accounts.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Chautauqua to alienate and discontinue the use of certain reforested lands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Chautauqua to alienate and discontinue the use of certain reforested lands.

sponsored.t: Provides for procedure in filling vacancies in the offices of comptroller and attorney-general
sponsored.sum: Provides for procedure in filling vacancies in the offices of comptroller and attorney-general.

sponsored.t: Regulates the discovery and disclosure of immigration status
sponsored.sum: Regulates the discovery and disclosure of immigration status; limits state officers, employees and law enforcement inquiring about an individual's immigration status.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Specialist Thomas Edwin Beglinger
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the county of Wyoming, constituting state route 98 from School Street in the town of Sheldon at the southern end to the southern line of the village of Attica, to Specialist Thomas Edwin Beglinger.

sponsored.t: Authorizes peace officers to seize certain e-bikes which are being operated outside the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Authorizes peace officers to seize certain e-bikes which are being operated outside the city of New York; establishes fines and fees for persons who unlawfully operate e-bikes outside the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to LTJG Brock Wendel Yates
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system on state route 19 in the county of Wyoming to LTJG Brock Wendel Yates.

sponsored.t: Prevents the financial exploitation of older and vulnerable adults
sponsored.sum: Allows for investment advisers and firms to disclose potential financial exploitation of elderly and vulnerable adults to the commissioner of the department of financial services and to halt disbursements from an account if an adviser or firm believes that financial exploitation is occurring.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the canine officer health monitoring fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the canine officer health monitoring fund which allows for applicants to request reimbursement from the division of criminal justice services for health costs related to regular health or injury associated with canine officers.

sponsored.t: Permits schools located within the state to purchase certain New York milk
sponsored.sum: Permits schools located within the state to purchase reduced fat or whole New York milk to provide or sell at such school.

sponsored.t: Establishes an annual spending growth cap
sponsored.sum: Establishes an annual spending growth cap.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the taxpayer voter registration act
sponsored.sum: Allows taxpayers to register to vote upon paying their taxes or changing their address.
sponsored.fis: The department of tax and finance and the state board of elections will incur additional staff and computer expense.

sponsored.t: Relates to the appointment process for state board positions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the appointment process for state board positions; provides for a 60 day time period to conduct a background check on potential nominees to state board positions before they can officially be appointed.

sponsored.t: Enacts the voter registration integrity act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the voter registration integrity act; requires a birth certificate, passport, certificate of naturalization or citizenship, evidence of New York state residency, or any other documentation that the board of elections determines establishes United States citizenship.
sponsored.fis: The board of elections will incur additional staff and computer expense to ensure that appropriate documents are submitted as part of the voter registration process.

sponsored.t: Provides for the payment of state aid to the town of New Hudson and special districts therein for state land operated by the department of environmental conservation
sponsored.sum: Provides for the payment of state aid to the town of New Hudson and special districts therein for state land operated by the department of environmental conservation.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a first permanent payroll employee tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a first permanent payroll employee tax credit which allows a business to receive a tax credit for the three years following the employment of such business' first permanent payroll employee where such credit equals a portion of the amount it costs to employ such permanent payroll employee.
sponsored.fis: The tax credit is capped at $15 million per year.

sponsored.t: Provides for the payment of state aid to the town of Ashford, in the county of Cattaraugus, for state land therein
sponsored.sum: Provides for the payment of state aid to the town of Ashford, in the county of Cattaraugus, for state lands in such town.

sponsored.t: Relates to designating, as peace officers, public safety officers of the Chautauqua Institution within the grounds of and properties owned by the Chautauqua Institution
sponsored.sum: Designates, as peace officers, public safety officers of the Chautauqua Institution within the grounds of and properties owned by the Chautauqua Institution.

sponsored.t: Allows for in-state suppliers to receive preference in certain situations when the state is awarding contracts
sponsored.sum: Allows for in-state suppliers to receive preference in certain situations when the state is awarding contracts.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Cattaraugus to discontinue as parklands and lease certain reforested lands in the town of Perrysburg
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Cattaraugus to discontinue as parklands and lease certain reforested lands in the town of Perrysburg.

sponsored.t: Creates the crime of stolen valor
sponsored.sum: Creates the crime of stolen valor; makes such crime a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Restores the legislative checks and balances to any emergency declaration that exceeds 45 days and ensures judicial due process rights for any action that impairs fundamental constitutional rights
sponsored.sum: Restores the legislative checks and balances to any emergency declaration that exceeds forty-five days; ensures judicial due process rights for any action that impairs fundamental constitutional rights by limiting the powers of the governor to suspend laws during a state disaster emergency; requires a specification and explanation of which municipalities are affected by such suspension of laws.

sponsored.t: Relates to paid sick leave provided by employers with full-time employee equivalents
sponsored.sum: Relates to paid sick leave provided by employers with full-time employee equivalents.

sponsored.t: Increases the tax exemption amount on clothing and apparel items from one hundred ten dollars to two hundred fifty dollars
sponsored.sum: Increases the tax exemption amount on clothing and apparel items from one hundred ten dollars to two hundred fifty dollars.
sponsored.fis: The fiscal impact of this legislation is undetermined

sponsored.t: Designates the uniformed court officers of the town of Busti, as peace officers
sponsored.sum: Designates the uniformed court officers of the town of Busti, in the county of Chautauqua, as peace officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting ballot harvesting
sponsored.sum: Prohibits ballot harvesting; prohibits a person from submitting an application for an absentee ballot on behalf of a voter without notarized consent; permits family members, caregivers and other officials to submit applications.

sponsored.t: Prohibits statewide elected officers and certain appointed officers from receiving compensation for any book or other published work written during the course of their term of service
sponsored.sum: Prohibits statewide elected officers and certain appointed officers from receiving compensation for any book or other published work written during the course of their term of service.

sponsored.t: Requires electors to vote for the presidential and vice presidential candidates in a manner representing the plurality of votes in each congressional district
sponsored.sum: Requires electors to vote for the presidential and vice presidential candidates in a manner representing the plurality of votes in each congressional district; provides that two electoral votes shall be given to the statewide winner and one electoral vote shall be given to each congressional district based on the plurality of votes in such district.

sponsored.t: Establishes a moratorium on the building or placing of any permanent or semi-permanent wind turbine
sponsored.sum: Establishes a moratorium on the building or placing of any permanent or semi-permanent wind turbine on bodies of freshwater located within the state and within the jurisdiction and control of the state.

sponsored.t: Eliminates the maximum age for taking the civil service examination for appointment as a police officer or as an environmental conservation officer
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the maximum age for taking the civil service examination for appointment as a police officer or as an environmental conservation officer.

sponsored.t: Relates to the justified use of physical force
sponsored.sum: Relates to the justified use of physical force; removes requirement that a person facing an imminent physical threat must retreat; provides immunity from civil and criminal liability.

sponsored.t: Requires instruction in agriculture
sponsored.sum: Requires instruction in agriculture in every elementary, middle, and high school under state control or supported wholly or partly by the state.

sponsored.t: Excludes certain real property conveyances from the written notice requirement
sponsored.sum: Excludes real property conveyances from the written notice requirement when such property is being conveyed by the state of New York or any of its political subdivisions as part of a foreclosure proceeding.

sponsored.t: Provides that certain real property tax exemptions shall only be granted where such property is actually used for certain enumerated purposes
sponsored.sum: Provides that real property tax exemptions granted to real property owned by corporations or associations organized or conducted exclusively for hospital or for purposes related to the moral or mental improvement of men, women, or children and used exclusively for carrying out such purposes shall only be granted if the property owner can prove by clear and convincing evidence that each acre is actually used for such purpose at least 120 days a year.
sponsored.fis: None to State - any state aid payments pursuant to section 3 of the act are subject to future appropriation by the legislature

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for affidavit ballots and absentee ballots
sponsored.sum: Requires voters voting by affidavit ballot to produce an identification document to verify residency in the election district; requires absentee ballots to be received by election day, or be post-marked by the first day of early voting.

sponsored.t: Requires housing affordability impact notes in relation to certain rules
sponsored.sum: Requires housing affordability impact notes in relation to rules with the purpose or effect to increase or decrease the cost of constructing, purchasing, owning or selling a single family residence or a multi-unit housing development, either directly or indirectly.

sponsored.t: Relates to the internet sale of raffle tickets
sponsored.sum: Relates to the internet sale of raffle tickets.

sponsored.t: Provides that each fire district, department or company required to provide enhanced cancer disability benefits for volunteer fire fighters shall be entitled to reimbursement by the state
sponsored.sum: Provides that each fire district, department or company required to provide enhanced cancer disability benefits for volunteer fire fighters pursuant to section two hundred five-cc of the general municipal law shall be entitled to reimbursement by the state for payments made in order to obtain the insurance coverage necessary to satisfy the requirements of section two hundred five-cc of the general municipal law.

sponsored.t: Relates to landowner recreational liability and farm and horseback riding operation liability relief; and enacts the "equine activity safety code act"
sponsored.sum: Limits the liability of a farm or "u-pick" operation for injuries incurred while a person was picking and buying agricultural products; expands the limited exemption of a property owner from liability to a property owner who makes their premises available to others for any recreational use and to include owners of underdeveloped and/or land used in agricultural production; enacts the "equine activity safety code act".
sponsored.fis: Overall savings to taxpayers due to a reduction in the hidden taxes they pay to support the tort system in New York will be substantial.

sponsored.t: Relates to dental, medical and podiatric malpractice actions and to establishing a limitation on noneconomic damages in personal injury actions
sponsored.sum: Requires a certificate of merit in actions for damages, contribution or indemnity arising out of alleged negligence of a professional licensed pursuant to the education law; establishes a party in an action for medical, dental or podiatric malpractice may not omit the name of certain experts in responding to a request; limits judgments for past and future damages in an action to recover damages for dental, medical or podiatric malpractice; limits compensation for noneconomic damages suffered by an injured plaintiff in any personal injury action to $250,000.
sponsored.fis: According to the U.S. Chamber Institute for Legal Reform, in 2011 New York State's "Tort Tax" amounted to $20 billion.

sponsored.t: Provides that a person is guilty of harassment in the first degree if such person strikes, shoves, kicks, et cetera a school employee
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person is guilty of harassment in the first degree, a class B misdemeanor, when such person strikes, shoves, kicks or otherwise subjects a school employee to physical contact or attempts or threatens to do the same while such school employee is engaged in the performance of such person's duties as a school employee.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing a space on a certificate of title for an owner to designate a beneficiary to whom the vehicle shall be transferred upon the death of the owner
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing a space on a certificate of title for an owner to designate a beneficiary to whom the vehicle shall be transferred upon the death of the owner.

sponsored.t: Provides that written notice of premium rate changes be given not less than sixty days prior to the effective date of such rate changes
sponsored.sum: Provides written notice of premium rate changes not less than sixty days prior to the effective date of such rate changes.

sponsored.t: Requires that recipients of public assistance benefits must be residents of the state for at least ninety days prior to applying for such benefits
sponsored.sum: Requires that recipients of public assistance benefits must be residents of the state for at least ninety days prior to applying for such benefits.

sponsored.t: Relates to security and protection of New York national guard recruiting centers
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of military and naval affairs to establish policies relating to security and protection of New York national guard and air national guard recruiting centers.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the DEC from restricting the burning of garbage, refuse or rubbish in an open fire under certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the DEC from restricting the burning of garbage, refuse or rubbish in an open fire on land possessed by a single family or any part of a farm under certain circumstances; provides for the repeal of such provisions under the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the abatement of municipal and school real property taxes in certain cases of catastrophic loss and establishes procedures therefor
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the abatement of real property taxes in certain cases of catastrophic loss; establishes procedures therefor; limits eligibility to one, two, or three family houses; applies to all municipal and school taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting cranes from the petroleum business tax
sponsored.sum: Relates to exempting cranes from the petroleum business tax.

sponsored.t: Reduces the amount a utility can be assessed for costs and expenses of the department of public service and the public service commission from one percent to one-third of one percent
sponsored.sum: Reduces the total amount that can be charged from one percent to one-third of one percent.
sponsored.fis: Consumers will save money from this unnecessary tax. A $520 million loss of projected revenue to the State's General Fund over the next 5 years by repealing the utility service conservation assessment.

sponsored.t: Extends eligibility for the agricultural property tax credit to farmers having a leasehold interest of not fewer than five years in qualified agricultural property
sponsored.sum: Extends eligibility for the agricultural property tax credit to farmers having a leasehold interest of not fewer than five continuous years in qualified agricultural property.

sponsored.t: Relates to appointments to the cannabis control board, and to oversight of registered cannabis organizations
sponsored.sum: Relates to appointments to the cannabis control board; relates to seed-to-sale tracking and reporting for registered cannabis organizations; relates to state and local inspections of registered cannabis organizations.

sponsored.t: Exempts livestock guardian dogs and herding dogs from license fees
sponsored.sum: Exempts livestock guardian dogs and herding dogs from license fees relating to the licensing, identification and control of dogs.

sponsored.t: Relates to the formula for the real property tax cap
sponsored.sum: Relates to the formula for the real property tax cap.

sponsored.t: Awards grants to municipalities for capital improvement projects; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Awards grants to municipalities for any non-transportation related capital improvement projects with a maximum cumulative grant award not exceeding $250,000; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York Business Emergency Relief Act of 2025"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York Business Emergency Relief Act"; directs the governor to use unallocated settlement funds reserved in the economic uncertainties, and any further settlement money received by the state or state surplus funds to pay the debt to the federal unemployment insurance trust fund.
sponsored.fis: According to the United States Treasury, as of August 22, 2022, New York State owes $7.759 billion to the federal Unemployment Trust Fund.

sponsored.t: Establishes the civil rights restoration act and amends provisions of law regarding firearm licenses; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the civil rights restoration act; amends provisions regarding firearm licenses and destruction of firearms; exempts certain individuals from providing photographs in order to obtain a firearm license; expands the definition of immediate family.
sponsored.fis: This act will save the State money being spent on implementation of the ammunition background check, the keeper of the ammunition, and the pistol license recertification. Additionally the State would see signif- icant cost-savings on money being spent on the "Integrated SAFE Act Reporting System", its implementation, training, expansion and oper- ations. With the enactment of this legislation, the State will incur costs for the written notification of persons reported into law enforce- ment databases, both past and for any on-going reporting. It will also require funding for assigned counsel for indigent legal services at pistol license hearings.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition and registration of mobility dealers
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition and registration of mobility dealers.

sponsored.t: Relates to building new one-family residential construction
sponsored.sum: Relates to building new one-family residential construction.
sponsored.fis: None to the State of New York or local governments. However, contractors engaged in new one-family residential construction will realize consid- erable savings. It is also anticipated that the cost of new homes will decrease.

sponsored.t: Relates to comptroller oversight of tribal-state compacts prior to federal approval
sponsored.sum: Directs the comptroller to review and provide a recommendation of approval or modifications, for submission for federal approval of any tribal-state compact approved or executed between the state of New York, the governor, or their designee and an Indian nation or tribe.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax credit in the amount of certain fees charged in connection with loans under the federal home loan guarantee program to national guard and reserve vets
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit in the amount of certain fees charged in connection with loans under the federal home loan guarantee program to national guard and reserve veterans.

sponsored.t: Requires certain meetings between the governor, the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly relating to the state budget to be open to the general public
sponsored.sum: Requires certain meetings between the governor, the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly relating to the state budget to be open to the general public; to provide an opportunity for the public to attend, listen to, and observe such meetings; and to broadcast and maintain records of such meetings on each party's website.

sponsored.t: Relates to payment of the governor's salary
sponsored.sum: Requires withholding the governor's salary until the legislative passage of the budget occurs.

sponsored.t: Requires that the manufacture and distribution of electric vehicles, wind turbines, solar collectors and infrastructure to upgrade the power grid is conducted using only wind and solar energy
sponsored.sum: Requires that the manufacture and distribution of electric vehicles, wind turbines, solar collectors and infrastructure to upgrade the power grid is conducted using only wind and solar energy and does not use any power derived from fossil fuels, nuclear energy or any form of combustion; amends definitions within the clean-fueled vehicle and buses projects to require such vehicles are manufactured and distributed using only wind and solar energy.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the public use of cannabis, unless approved by the applicable local government
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of cannabis in public places, unless approved by the applicable local government.

sponsored.t: Increases the maximum sentence of imprisonment for certain misdemeanors to one year; repealer
sponsored.sum: Increases the maximum sentence of imprisonment for certain misdemeanors to one year.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Olean assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Olean Community Theatre, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Cattaraugus assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Olean Community Theatre, Inc. for all of the 2021-2022 school taxes and all of the 2022 general taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the granting of certificates for the construction or operation of industrial wind turbines
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the granting of a certificate for the construction or operation of an on-shore or off-shore industrial wind turbine or wind farm within the jurisdiction and control of the state and within any area of the state outside of the city of New York unless a certificate for the construction or operation of an on-shore or off-shore industrial wind turbine or wind farm within geographic boundaries of or the shoreline adjacent to the city of New York is granted simultaneously.

sponsored.t: Permits certain judges, justices and support magistrates to carry a firearm, rifle, or shotgun in a sensitive location
sponsored.sum: Permits certain judges, justices and support magistrates to carry a firearm, rifle, or shotgun in a sensitive location.

sponsored.t: Requires curriculum or instruction in Italian history and civic impact
sponsored.sum: Requires curriculum or instruction in Italian history and civic impact in all public school districts in the state.

sponsored.t: Repeals the requirement that any person, firm or corporation that sells or offers for sale at retail any motor fuel for use in internal combustion engines in motor vehicles or motorboats posts certain signage
sponsored.sum: Repeals the requirement that any person, firm or corporation that sells or offers for sale at retail any motor fuel for use in internal combustion engines in motor vehicles or motorboats posts on the dispensing device signage stating the price per gallon of such motor fuel.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Cattaraugus to discontinue as reforested lands certain reforested lands in the town of Perrysburg
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Cattaraugus to discontinue as reforested lands certain reforested lands in the town of Perrysburg.

sponsored.t: Increases the number of members on the farm laborers wage board from three to five
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of members on the farm laborers wage board from three to five; adds as members the commissioner of agriculture and markets and a member appointed by the Dean of the Cornell University's College of Agriculture and Life Sciences.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of unmanned aerial vehicles to aid in hunting
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of unmanned aerial vehicles to search for, scout, locate, hunt, detect, or otherwise aid in the taking of a wild animal to which the hunting season applies.

sponsored.t: Requires grocery stores that offer digital coupons automatically apply such coupons for senior citizens
sponsored.sum: Requires grocery stores that offer digital coupons automatically apply such coupons for senior citizens and loyalty or rewards program members.

sponsored.t: Lowers the required service life threshold for consolidated local street and highway improvement program capital projects
sponsored.sum: Lowers the required service life threshold for consolidated local street and highway improvement program capital projects from ten years to five years.

sponsored.t: Relates to environmental quality reviews of certain housing development projects
sponsored.sum: Relates to environmental quality reviews of housing development projects that propose to build twenty or more units; provides that municipalities shall not be prohibited from performing their own environmental reviews.

sponsored.t: Exempts minority depository institutions from certain filing requirements
sponsored.sum: Exempts minority depository institutions which are subject to the Community Reinvestment Act of 1977 from report and document filing requirements with the superintendent of financial services for a period of ten years from commencement of business.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sale of a mortgaged premises after a judgment of sale has been entered
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Provides that a judgment of sale as a result of an action to foreclose a mortgage shall direct the mortgaged premises to be sold within forty-five days of the date of the judgment.

sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for traffic infractions related to the operation of vehicles when approaching authorized emergency vehicles
sponsored.sum: Increases penalties for traffic violations related to the failure to properly operate a motor vehicle when approaching a parked, stopped or standing authorized emergency vehicle, hazard vehicle, vehicle displaying a blue or green light or certain other motor vehicles; increases penalties for multiple violations.

sponsored.t: Requires at least two photo speed violation monitoring systems in highway construction or maintenance work areas located on a controlled-access highway or on the thruway
sponsored.sum: Requires at least two photo speed violation monitoring systems in highway construction or maintenance work areas located on a controlled-access highway or on the thruway.

sponsored.t: Establishes the study commission on preventing snow emergencies
sponsored.sum: Establishes the study commission on preventing snow emergencies to evaluate the impact of grid electrification on the safety and reliability of heating systems in snowstorms that cause power outages, and to develop strategies and best practices to maximize grid reliability and resiliency during extreme winter weather events.

sponsored.t: Establishes the parole board accountability act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the parole board accountability act which requires incarcerated individuals who are released on parole, via a vote that is not unanimous, be placed in the community where one of the two board members primarily reside; establishes the procedure of which of the two board member's community the releasee shall be released to.

sponsored.t: Ensures zero-emission school buses and major components thereof are manufactured and assembled within the United States and provides for waivers of zero-emission school bus requirements in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Ensures zero-emission school buses and major components thereof are manufactured and assembled within the United States; provides for waivers of zero-emission school bus requirements in certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to the residency requirement for public office in counties in the state; repealer
sponsored.sum: Removes the residency requirement for all public office positions employed by a county; provides that counties shall have the authority to determine residency requirements for each county job on a county by county basis.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Emmaline Wilcox
sponsored.sum: Dedicates the portion of state route 60 between Shumla Road and Lakeview Road in the town of Pomfret, county of Chautauqua, to Emmaline Wilcox.

sponsored.t: Exempts minority depository institutions from the corporate franchise tax for a period of ten years
sponsored.sum: Exempts minority depository institutions from the corporate franchise tax for a period of ten years from the date of commencement of business.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain inland lakes from wetlands designations
sponsored.sum: Exempts inland lakes which are navigable waterways and have an area of 150 acres or more from wetlands designations, not including great lakes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes local municipalities and political subdivisions to have final say on if a renewable energy power plant can be sited in such municipalities or political subdivision's jurisdiction
sponsored.sum: Authorizes local municipalities and political subdivisions to have final say on if a renewable energy power plant can be sited in such municipalities' or political subdivisions' jurisdiction; establishes conflict of interest standards for approving the siting of a renewable energy power plant in a local municipality or political subdivision; requires the office of renewable energy siting and electric transmissions establish a database to collect and display host agreements and land contracts for renewable energy power plants; establishes contract standards concerning the forfeiture of mineral rights for the siting of renewable energy power plants; regulates the conduct of businesses engaged…

sponsored.t: Provides a $500,000 supplemental valuation impact grant to the West Valley central school district during the 2024-2025 school year
sponsored.sum: Provides a $500,000 supplemental valuation impact grant to the West Valley central school district during the 2024--2025 school year.
sponsored.fis: $500,000, subject to appropriation in the state budget.

sponsored.t: Eliminates the zero-emission school bus mandate; repealer
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the zero-emission school bus mandate; authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority conduct a study to determine the feasibility of converting school buses to zero-emission vehicles.

sponsored.t: Requires financial security for reclamation for solar and wind electric generating systems
sponsored.sum: Requires financial security for reclamation for solar and wind electric generating systems.

sponsored.t: Authorizes lifetime sporting licenses to be purchased by permanently disabled veterans at a discounted rate
sponsored.sum: Authorizes lifetime sporting licenses, which includes hunting and fishing licenses and turkey permits, to be purchased by permanently disabled veterans at a discounted rate of sixty-five dollars.

sponsored.t: Includes retirement plans in the exemption for pensions and annuities for certain persons and increases such exemption
sponsored.sum: Includes retirement plans in the exemption for pensions and annuities for certain persons; increases such exemption to one hundred thousand dollars as adjusted by the consumer price index annually.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing judges more discretion regarding securing orders and limiting the lengths of certain orders; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing judges more discretion regarding securing orders and limiting the lengths of certain orders.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Pavilion in Genesee county to share and hold justice court in the town of Covington in Wyoming county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Pavilion in Genesee county to share and hold justice court in the town of Covington in Wyoming county.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Franklynn Smith to take the competitive civil service examination and be placed on the eligible list for appointment as a full-time police officer with the village of Perry
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Franklynn Smith, who has been continuously employed as a part-time police officer, to take the competitive civil service examination and be placed on the eligible list for appointment as a full-time police officer with the village of Perry.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Brian Studley, a police officer employed by the New York state university police department at SUNY Fredonia, to participate in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Brian Studley, a police officer employed by the New York state university police department at SUNY Fredonia, to transition his pension from the New York state and local employees' retirement system to the New York state and local police and fire retirement system.

sponsored.t: Suspends employer contributions to the interest assessment surcharge fund; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Suspends employer contributions to the interest assessment surcharge fund until December 31, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the animal abuse hotline
sponsored.sum: Establishes the animal abuse hotline.
sponsored.fis: FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS: None

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing grocery store wine licenses
sponsored.sum: Establishes grocery store wine licenses permitting the licensee to sell from the licensed premises wine produced in New York state or produced from ingredients grown or produced in New York state, in sealed containers for consumption off such premises.

sponsored.t: Establishes the city of Dunkirk interim finance authority; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the city of Dunkirk interim finance authority; provides for its functions, powers and duties; repeals the city of Dunkirk fiscal recovery act.

sponsored.t: Authorizes retail licensees of liquor and/or wine for off-premises consumption to apply for licensure as a retail food store
sponsored.sum: Authorizes retail licensees of liquor and/or wine for off-premises consumption to apply for licensure as a retail food store.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain motor vehicle license plates; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides for fines and/or imprisonment for a person who knowingly sells, offers to sell, buys, or offers to buy a false, fraudulent, or stolen license, identification card, certificate of registration, or number plate.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to LCpl. Joseph Bailey
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system on state route 39 in the county of Wyoming to LCpl. Joseph Bailey.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Corporal Kermit Davis
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system on state route 39 in the county of Wyoming to Corporal Kermit Davis.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Batavia to alienate certain parklands for use as a municipal parking lot and to preserve the historic Brisbane mansion
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Batavia to alienate certain parklands for use as a municipal parking lot and to preserve the historic Brisbane mansion.

sponsored.t: Extends the expiration of the authorization to the county of Wyoming to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the expiration of the authorization to the county of Wyoming to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax from November 30, 2025 to November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the expiration of the authorization to the county of Genesee to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the expiration of the authorization to the county of Genesee to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax from 11/30/2025 to 11/30/2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Genesee to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Genesee to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property until November 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the expiration of the provisions authorizing the county of Allegany to impose an additional one and one-half percent sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the expiration of the provisions authorizing the county of Allegany to impose an additional one and one-half percent sales and compensating use taxes until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the city of Olean's authority to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the city of Olean's authority to impose a hotel and motel tax.
sponsored.fis: This legislation allows the City of Olean to continue collecting revenue from the hotel and motel tax, ensuring stable funding for local programs.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Cattaraugus to impose an additional mortgage recording tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Cattaraugus to impose an additional mortgage recording tax until December 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the expiration of the provisions authorizing the county of Cattaraugus to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the expiration of the provisions authorizing the county of Cattaraugus to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use taxes until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for Chautauqua county to impose an additional one percent rate of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for Chautauqua county to impose an additional one percent rate of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for the allocation of revenue from the hotel and motel taxes in Chautauqua county; extends the authorization for such taxes.
